metadata.title: EU AI Act High-Risk Baseline (Title III)
metadata.remarks: The complete Title III obligation set for high-risk AI systems under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, resolved as a baseline. It imports every control in the hand-authored eu-ai-act catalog: classification (Articles 6 to 7), the Chapter 2 requirements for high-risk systems (Articles 8 to 15), and provider and deployer obligations (Articles 16 to 27, as present in the catalog). A project whose AI system is high-risk adopts this profile as its baseline; security review verifies the code-relevant requirements (notably Articles 9 to 15, 12, and 19) against it. Honest framing: this is a learning and practice representation authored from the EUR-Lex text, not a conformity assessment under the Regulation.

resources.title: Selection rationale
resources.description: Title III of the EU AI Act is already scoped to high-risk AI systems, so the high-risk baseline is the whole of it rather than a subset. All 18 controls present in the catalog are included: Articles 6 and 7 (classification), Articles 8 through 15 (the requirements for high-risk systems: compliance, risk management, data governance, technical documentation, record-keeping, transparency, human oversight, and accuracy with robustness and cybersecurity), and Articles 16 through 27 (provider and deployer obligations, quality management, documentation, automatically generated logs, corrective actions, value-chain responsibilities, and the fundamental-rights impact assessment). Articles 21 through 24 are not part of the catalog and are therefore not selected. Code-level security review focuses on Articles 9 through 15, 12, and 19; the remaining articles are organizational obligations retained so the baseline represents the full Title III duty set.
